title: Loukoumades with Honey and Caramel Sauce
description: A traditional Greek dessert made with crispy honey balls and topped with a sweet caramel sauce.

ingredients.name: Loukoumades (Greek doughnuts)
ingredients.notes: available in most Greek or Mediterranean markets

instructions: Fry loukoumades according to package instructions.
Drain excess oil on paper towels.
Dip fried loukoumades in honey, then in caramel sauce.
Repeat the process for a thicker coating.
Serve warm or at room temperature with a dollop of Greek yogurt, if desired.
